result.summary: The page is mostly intact, but the 'Popular right now' section contains a broken/missing restaurant image displayed as a grey placeholder with a broken-image icon.

issues.description: The first restaurant card under 'Popular right now' (Tokumaru Ramen Bar) shows a grey placeholder with a broken-image icon instead of the restaurant photo.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image source/URL, ensure the asset loads correctly, and add a fallback placeholder or hide the card until the image is available.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel appears truncated at the right edge of the card.
issues.suggestion: Allow text wrapping, truncate with ellipsis, or widen the card to fully display long restaurant names.
